Bill.BriefDescription: Including international companies investing in Washington in the definition of "person" for the purposes of excise tax incentives.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to including international companies investing inWashington in the definition of "person" for the purposes of excise taxincentives; amending RCW 82.04.030; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that manyinternational companies with an interest in operating in Washington arenot aware of the various tax incentives that are available. It is theintent of the legislature to clarify that persons eligible for businessand occupation tax credits and sales and use tax deferrals andexemptions include international companies investing in Washington. Itis the further intent of the legislature that the department ofcommunity, trade, and economic development and associate developmentorganizations make clear to international companies that they areeligible for the state's various tax incentives.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.04.030 and 1995 c 318 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Person" or "company", herein used interchangeably, means anyindividual, receiver, administrator, executor, assignee, trustee in p. 1 SB 5983bankruptcy, trust, estate, firm, copartnership, joint venture, club,company, international company investing in Washington, joint stockcompany, business trust, municipal corporation, political subdivisionof the state of Washington, corporation, limited liability company,association, society, or any group of individuals acting as a unit,whether mutual, cooperative, fraternal, nonprofit, or otherwise and theUnited States or any instrumentality thereof.
